purpose: One-time read-only diagnostic of account billable-usage rows; not a zero-cost or runtime-activation authority.

execution.history_check: Require exactly this first-attempt dispatch as the only run of this workflow on main.
execution.date_window: UTC current calendar month start through current UTC date; one request, maximum 31 days.

allowed_operations: One GitHub Actions workflow-history metadata request.
One bounded read-only Cloudflare billable-usage request.
Secret-free summary and short-retention report artifact.
forbidden_operations: Any rerun, retry, pagination, second Cloudflare request, or fallback endpoint.
Any R2 object, D1 database, provider, market-data, or account-inventory access.
Any inference that missing rows, missing cost fields, or an empty response means zero usage or zero cost.
Any provisioning, migration, budget activation, Cloud Paper execution, schedule activation, training, holdout access, promotion, or trading.
